purpose: Offline Tripo3D generation and game-asset integration queue for MOWBOT.
usage: Run generation tasks through the connected Tripo MCP, then complete cleanup and integration tasks locally.

defaults.style: stylized low-poly racing-cartoon robot lawnmower game asset, chunky readable silhouette, clean bevels, flat-shaded surfaces with restrained PBR materials, no text, no logos, no background, no floating parts
defaults.camera: orthographic isometric three-quarter view, front of the asset facing +Z, standing on a neutral ground plane for review only
defaults.scale: real-world proportions are not required; export with the origin at bottom-center and dimensions documented in meters
defaults.runtimeFormat: GLB with embedded textures, applied transforms, clean normals, no hidden cameras or lights
defaults.textureBudget: 512px for small props, 1024px for mower and large props
defaults.triangleBudget: mower 5k-15k triangles, large prop 1k-8k, small prop under 2k
defaults.runtimeRule: visual meshes do not define gameplay collision; keep collision primitives in the engine and physics systems
defaults.referenceRule: use only original or cleared reference images; preserve task IDs, model versions, prompts, and license tier

taskGroups.label: MOWBOT modular mower models
taskGroups.generationNotes: Generate the hero chassis first. Generate parts against the same approved reference and attachment dimensions; do not generate five unrelated complete mowers.

tasks.prompt: A friendly autonomous robot lawnmower named MOWBOT, compact industrial chassis, rounded rectangular shell, wide cutting deck, two visible drive wheels, front bumper, dark glass sensor panel, small antenna, expressive but non-anthropomorphic design, original game asset, stylized low-poly, bold red blue yellow and dark graphite accent panels, suitable for an isometric browser game.
acceptance: no accidental text or brand marks
all major parts are separate or clearly named

tasks.prompt: Simple square starter body shell for the approved MOWBOT chassis; sturdy entry-level robot mower body, clean planar panels and small bevels, visually distinct from the other shells while preserving the same attachment points.
acceptance: same origin and scale as hero chassis

tasks.prompt: Rounded aerodynamic body shell for the approved MOWBOT chassis; smooth friendly shell with broad shoulders and protected sensor housing, low-poly faceted treatment, same attachment points as the base body.
acceptance: same origin and scale as hero chassis
clear visual difference from basic, heavy, wedge, and scout shells

tasks.prompt: Heavy-duty utility body shell for the approved MOWBOT chassis; wider reinforced side panels, protective bumper blocks, practical service hatches, chunky low-poly construction, same attachment points as the base body.
acceptance: communicates heavier mass without excessive detail
same origin and scale as hero chassis

tasks.prompt: Low wedge-shaped performance body shell for the approved MOWBOT chassis; tapered front, sharp but safe aerodynamic planes, racing-cartoon energy, low-poly construction, same attachment points as the base body.
acceptance: same origin and scale as hero chassis

tasks.prompt: Small compact scout body shell for the approved MOWBOT chassis; narrow footprint, raised sensor brow, nimble friendly proportions, low-poly construction, same attachment points as the base body.
acceptance: same origin and scale as hero chassis

tasks.prompt: Pair of chunky robot lawnmower drive wheels with simple hubs and thick turf tread, stylized low-poly, designed to mount to the approved MOWBOT chassis, clean left-right symmetry, no branding.
Pair of compact continuous rubber turf tracks for the approved MOWBOT chassis, rounded low-poly track housings, visible tread pattern but lightweight geometry, friendly autonomous mower game asset.
acceptance: same mount spacing as wheel set
track texture does not shimmer at game camera distance

tasks.method: derive one shared deck with three geometry variants
tasks.prompt: Three compatible robot mower cutting deck variants: starter deck, wide deck, and precision edge deck. Low-poly circular or softly polygonal deck housings, safe enclosed cutting underside, clean attachment point to MOWBOT chassis, no exposed dangerous blades.
acceptance: all variants share center and mount
blade animation can be applied as a child node

tasks.method: derive three modules from approved chassis
tasks.prompt: Three visible swappable battery modules for a stylized autonomous mower: stock compact module, long-range elongated module, and fast-charge taller module. Industrial low-poly housings with simple status lights and a shared mounting bay.
acceptance: status lights are separate meshes or materials

tasks.method: derive three modules from approved chassis
tasks.prompt: Three compatible front sensor upgrades for MOWBOT: basic bumper, hazard-ping bumper with amber side lights, and wide-scan sensor with cyan scanning lens. Low-poly, readable from an isometric camera, shared attachment point.
acceptance: lights and scanner are independently addressable

tasks.method: generate one concept, split into three compatible attachments
tasks.prompt: Three friendly cargo-handling attachments for an autonomous robot lawnmower: basic front claw, twin grabber arms, and a magnet boom. Mechanical but playful low-poly design, clear hinge joints, compact enough for an isometric browser game, same rear/front attachment convention.
acceptance: carried objects do not intersect the chassis

tasks.prompt: Minimal autonomous robot mower charging dock: low rectangular charging pad, two contact rails, subtle status light, chunky stylized low-poly game prop, no text or logo, clear front approach direction.
acceptance: mower can visually align to pad

tasks.prompt: Round plaza variation of the approved MOWBOT charging dock, circular pad, friendly trim, same charging point and mower approach dimensions.
Signal beacon variation of the approved MOWBOT charging dock, tall amber beacon, compact rail pad, readable at isometric distance, same charging point and footprint.
Solar canopy variation of the approved MOWBOT charging dock, two slim posts and a small angled solar roof, clean low-poly construction, same charging pad and mower approach.
acceptance: does not block mower or camera
canopy casts an intentional soft shadow

taskGroups.label: Yard and level models
taskGroups.generationNotes: Use a small reusable kit. Buildings need variants and modular dimensions; roads, water, grass, and coverage remain procedural/material-driven unless a model proves materially better.

tasks.prompt: Stylized suburban ranch house kit for a cheerful robot lawnmower game: simple rectangular body, broad low roof, porch, windows as flat readable materials, chunky low-poly geometry, no text, designed to scale across multiple footprint sizes.
acceptance: building footprint can match existing level colliders
occluder fade can target the body and roof

tasks.prompt: Small lakeside cabin kit for a stylized robot lawnmower game: timber walls, simple pitched roof, porch step, warm windows, low-poly readable silhouette, no text, modular footprint.

Three stylized low-poly yard tree variants for an isometric robot lawnmower game: broad trunk, faceted leafy canopy, one small, one medium, one orchard-shaped, cheerful palette, no fruit required, no background.

tasks.method: generate a coherent prop sheet and split into meshes
tasks.prompt: Coherent low-poly yard prop kit for a robot lawnmower game: mailbox, lawn chair, garden cart, simple shrub, small rock, firepit, fence section, and flowerbed edging. Same stylized proportions and palette, no text, no background.
outputs: individual GLBs or named meshes for each prop
acceptance: materials can be recolored by the game

tasks.prompt: Friendly stylized low-poly yard dog for a family-safe robot lawnmower game, compact body, expressive ears and tail, four sturdy legs, no collar text, clear joints for idle walk flee and return animations, non-threatening.

Friendly stylized low-poly yard cat for a family-safe robot lawnmower game, compact body, upright ears, curved tail, four distinct legs, readable from an isometric camera, clear joints for idle walk flee and return animations.

Friendly stylized low-poly yard squirrel for a family-safe robot lawnmower game, small body, oversized fluffy tail, tiny readable paws, clear joints for idle hop flee and return animations, no background.

taskGroups.label: Hazards and pickups
taskGroups.generationNotes: Keep these visually simple and strongly color-coded. Interaction rings, warning pings, collection sparkle, and disintegration effects are Three.js effects, not Tripo models.

tasks.prompt: Coiled garden hose hazard, stylized low-poly game prop, blue-green rubber loop with simple nozzle, readable from an isometric lawnmower game camera, no text or background.
acceptance: coil remains visually separate from ground

tasks.prompt: Loose pet leash hazard on grass, stylized low-poly curved loop with clasp, readable and family-safe, no text, no background.
acceptance: reads as a loop from camera

tasks.prompt: Small colorful children's yard toy hazard set: toy truck, rubber ball, and chunky plastic block, stylized low-poly, family-safe, no text, no background.
Small pop-up lawn sprinkler hazard, stylized low-poly metal and plastic head, compact base, no water simulation required, no text or background.
acceptance: water spray can be added procedurally

tasks.prompt: Small friendly yard hand-tool hazard set: trowel, garden shears, and hand rake, stylized low-poly, rounded family-safe shapes, no text or background.
Small tipped pet water bowl on grass, stylized low-poly, readable from an isometric game camera, no text or background.

Small collectible yard-item set for a colorful robot lawnmower game: red apple, cyan frisbee, yellow ball, and tiny friendly critter token. Chunky faceted low-poly shapes, high readability, no text, no background.
acceptance: fits existing cargo and ring effects

taskGroups.label: Animation tasks
taskGroups.generationNotes: Mechanical mower animations should be implemented in Three.js from named nodes. Use Tripo rigging/retargeting only where it produces a clean result for animals; validate every clip in Blender before integration.

tasks.brief: Subtle idle loop: antenna sway, small sensor light pulse, and gentle body settle. Keep the chassis visually stable.
acceptance: does not move the gameplay root

tasks.brief: Spin wheel hubs or track textures based on signed mower speed. Stop when stationary and reverse direction when reversing.
acceptance: does not affect collision or movement state

tasks.method: Three.js procedural blade rotation and effect
tasks.brief: Rotate an enclosed deck blade node while cutting, stop in reserve mode or when docked, and add a lightweight grass-clipping effect.
acceptance: blade is never exposed as a dangerous visible prop
does not add one mesh per grass blade

tasks.brief: Short non-destructive bump reaction: small tilt, recoil, and light flash after a hazard or animal collision.

tasks.method: Three.js procedural alignment, light pulse, and particles
tasks.brief: Docking presentation: slow visual settle, contact-light activation, charging pulse, and optional small upward energy particles.
Hazard-ping and wide-scan upgrades show a readable cyan or amber sweep without changing sensor gameplay rules.
Open, close, and settle the equipped claw, grabber, or magnet boom when collecting and delivering a tree drop.
acceptance: works with all three arm styles
cargo remains attached to the engine carried state

tasks.method: rig-check, rig, and retarget if clean; otherwise Blender or procedural keyframes
tasks.brief: Dog animation set: idle, walk, alert, flee, and return. Family-safe, feet planted, readable at game scale.
acceptance: no foot skating that is visible from game camera

tasks.method: rig-check, rig, and retarget if clean; otherwise Blender or procedural keyframes
tasks.brief: Cat animation set: idle, walk, alert, flee, and return. Include a readable tail pose and soft non-threatening reactions.

tasks.method: rig-check, rig, and retarget if clean; otherwise Blender or procedural keyframes
tasks.brief: Squirrel animation set: idle, hop or walk, alert, flee, and return. Give the tail a readable bounce without excessive secondary motion.
Brief tree canopy and trunk shake when bumped, followed by a visible but lightweight drop spawn.
Slow hover, rotation, and collection pop for fruit, frisbee, ball, and critter-token pickups.

integrationTasks.brief: Create an asset registry mapping existing upgrade IDs and level object types to approved GLB files, with a procedural fallback for every asset.
Add GLB loading, caching, disposal, named-node lookup, material recoloring, and failure fallback without moving gameplay rules into the renderer.
Verify garage, gameplay, inspection cards, docking, results gallery, occlusion fade, desktop, and 320x568 mobile layouts with the new assets.
Run npm run check and record model load time, total GLB bytes, triangle count, draw calls, and representative renderer.info values before and after asset replacement.
